title: Household timezone in the planner views
lead: Make the planning page and the list generation use the configured household timezone for "today", as the Today view does.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** any new setting. `Settings.timezone` already exists.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `home_views.today(settings)` returns the date in `settings.timezone` (host local time when unset). `plan_views.today` is `date.today`, and the S24 generation follows the planner's host-local convention, so on a host whose clock is not in the household's timezone the three can disagree around midnight. Found in the S21 and S24 reviews.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: None. The household timezone is `Settings.timezone`, as ADR 0013's Saturday-evening session implies.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/larder/web/plan_views.py`
- `src/larder/shopping/generate.py` (wherever generation reads today's date; re-anchor at start)
- `tests/test_plan_web.py`, `tests/test_list_generate.py`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Take "today" from one helper that uses `settings.timezone`, shared with the Today view.
2. Replace `date.today` in the planner view and the list generation with it.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - The three tests pass, the full suite passes, and `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` exit 0.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Use the household timezone in the planner views (S69).
